I'd like to hear from each of you on any concerns or requirements from your areas so we can move this forward efficiently.

Marcus — please attach the executed award letter to the proposal as part of your finance review.

If everyone can make these amendments and route the updated plan through the four review areas, I'll be ready to sign once all four sign-offs are complete. Does anyone see any issues with this approach?
